Vietnam in 8 Days 🇻🇳 | Hanoi, Sapa, Ha Long Bay & Da Nang Itinerary for Indian Travelers
Contact us at: https://go.vietnamtour.in/u1UcMU

Discover the best of Vietnam with this 8-day itinerary covering Hanoi, Sapa, Ha Long Bay, and Da Nang. Perfectly designed for Indian travelers, this journey combines mountains, culture, cruising, and coastal beauty.

🌏 Detailed Itinerary:

Day 1: Arrival in Hanoi – Private transfer with guide
Day 2: Travel to Sapa → Visit Cat Cat Village (Private tour) (Breakfast)
Day 3: Conquer Fansipan peak → Return to Hanoi (Private tour) (Breakfast)
Day 4: Ha Long Bay overnight cruise with Dragon Premium Cruise (Private transfer) (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner)
Day 5: Ha Long Bay → Hanoi → Fly to Da Nang (Private transfers) (Breakfast, Brunch)
Day 6: Explore Cam Thanh Coconut Village → Hoi An city tour, boat ride & lantern release (Private tour) (Breakfast)
Day 7: Visit Ba Na Hills & Golden Bridge (Private tour) (Breakfast, Lunch)
Day 8: Departure from Da Nang – Private transfer (Breakfast)

✨ Why this itinerary is perfect for Indian travelers:

• Covers North and Central Vietnam in one trip
• Includes Sapa mountains, Ha Long Bay cruise, and Da Nang highlights
• Comfortable private transfers and guided tours
• Indian-friendly meals and travel support
• Ideal for families, couples, and adventure lovers

From the cultural charm of Hanoi to the mountain beauty of Sapa, the breathtaking Ha Long Bay cruise, and the coastal vibes of Da Nang & Hoi An, this itinerary offers a complete Vietnam experience in 8 days.
